# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Niraula helps early-stage tech startups turn what their customers already say into proof that buyers and AI search trust: customer interviews, reviews, testimonials, case studies, short videos, and placement on review sites and communities.

About: Former product manager and co-founder of a marketing agency that worked with 40+ brands, before going solo. M.S. in Technology Management from UCSB. Based in Santa Barbara, CA.

## Guides
- [Stop asking customers "How do you like our product?"](https://ultha.co/guides/stop-asking-how-do-you-like-our-product): 5 interview questions that get customers to tell real, specific stories instead of polite praise.
- [Your best sales pitch is buried in a Zoom recording](https://ultha.co/guides/your-best-sales-pitch-is-buried-in-a-zoom-recording): How to turn one 15-minute customer call into a 60-second video, short social clips, a written customer story and a sales one-pager, with customer approval.
